edges.method: ladder clips snapped onto handle bar of the 1x2 handle brick

notes: Step numbering runs through the whole booklet: bag 1 cave = steps 1-24, bag 2 spider = 25-32, bag 2 TNT/grass build = 33-42, chest platform = 43-50 (step 48 = placing the chest platform on the cave, step 50 = placing the minifigs). The 'Rebuild Inspiration' pages use no new pieces and are not counted.

Separate groups are genuine and kept: the cave, TNT/grass build and chest platform form one model (TNT build joined to the cave by the two 2x4 bricks of step 42, chest platform pushed onto the cave top in step 48). The spider (steps 25-32), the loose bucket with its handle and water stud (step 49), the loose orange round plate p179 (left lying beside the bucket in the final picture), and the pickaxe p1 (held by the Steve minifigure, whose body parts are not in the piece list) are separate objects in the booklet and are intentionally not connected to the main model.

Grid positions are reconstructed from the isometric drawings and are approximate: cave x 1-19, TNT/grass build x 16-27, spider x 30+, loose bucket/orange round at x 30-32, y 0. Layers are plates above the lowest brick.

Upside-down sub-assemblies: the 8x8 base plate p159 (booklet step 1, bricks p13/p14/p15/p39 clutched onto it in step 2), the 8x8 plate p160 (step 33 plate + bricks, reddish-brown bricks in step 34) and the 6x8 plate p144 (step 43 plate + first brick, other two bricks in step 44) end up sitting on top of their underside bricks after the model is flipped. So that rests_on matches the finished positions without a piece resting on something added later, each of those three plates is recorded at the step in which its last underside brick is attached (p159 = 2, p160 = 34, p144 = 44).

The chest platform's bottom 2x8 brick p93 rests only on the three jumper plates p239, p240, p241 (studded). The smooth tiles p150-p153 are placed on studs elsewhere on the cave top (p150/p153 on the 2x4 p22, p151 on the handle brick p115, p152 on the 2x2 brick p67), not under the platform. p94 and p95 (the other two 2x8 bricks under the platform plate) hang under the plate p144 and rest on nothing in the cave.

Ore-block sub-assemblies (steps 14 and 38) are modelled as base plate 2x2, then two round and two square 1x1 plates diagonally in one layer, then the swapped pair in the next layer, topped by a jumper plate.
Spider legs (plate 1x2 + clip plate + hinge assembly), T-bars, the lid, the bread, ladder and bucket handle are off-grid (position null) and connected with other_joins.
Torch assemblies: torch support + trans-yellow 1x1 plate + trans-orange 1x1 plate (p197/p118/p116 on the chest tower, p198/p119/p117 on the cave floor).
Colour/size splits of identical pieces (2x4 vs 2x6 bricks etc.) were assigned by counting the part quantities in the parts list at the back of the booklet.

notes: Step numbering runs through the whole booklet: bag 1 cave = steps 1-24, bag 2 spider = 25-32, bag 2 TNT/grass build = 33-42, chest platform = 43-50 (step 48 = placing the chest platform on the cave, step 50 = placing the minifigs). The 'Rebuild Inspiration' pages use no new pieces and are not counted.

Minifigure bodies (Steve and Zombie head/torso/legs) are not in the piece list and are not modelled. The pickaxe p1 is held by Steve's hand; it is off-grid and given step 1 (the minifig is built before step 1).

Grid positions are reconstructed from the isometric drawings and are approximate: the cave sits at x 1-19, the TNT/grass build at x 16-27 (joined to the cave in step 42 by two 2x4 bricks), the spider at x 30+, and the loose bucket and orange round plate at x 30-32, y 0. Layers are plates above the lowest brick.

Sub-assemblies built upside down (8x8 plate + bricks underneath in steps 2, 6, 33-34, 43-44): the plate is listed as resting on the bricks added in the same step; bricks added later than the plate are joined through other_joins instead, because a piece may only rest on pieces from the same or an earlier step.

Ore-block sub-assemblies (steps 14 and 38) are modelled as base plate 2x2, then two round and two square 1x1 plates diagonally in one layer, then the swapped pair in the next layer, topped by a jumper plate.

Spider legs (plate 1x2 + clip plate + hinge assembly) and T-bars are off-grid (position null); the head, T-bars and legs are connected with other_joins. Bread, chest lid, ladder, bucket handle are also off-grid.

Torch assemblies: torch support + trans-yellow 1x1 plate + trans-orange 1x1 plate (p197/p118/p116 on the chest tower, p198/p119/p117 on the cave floor). The water round plate p188 sits on the bucket p242; the orange round p179 is left loose beside it.
Colour/size splits of the identical pieces (2x4 vs 2x6 bricks etc.) were assigned by counting the part quantities in the parts list at the back of the booklet.
